positions.title: Software Engineer Intern

- Researched and developed tools to help standardize and improve the quality control of the product
- Integrated embedded HTTPS server and client which improved the efficiency and reliability of the older version by 70%
- Worked closely with a team in another country to develop and test new features

positions.title: Peer Educator
positions.description:
- A part of group that piloted Supplemental Instruction(SI) program at SJSU 
- Assist professor in Introduction to Programming(Java) class, in term of guiding the students, and answering questions
- Plan and faciliate study session to help students get a deeper understanding on the concept and succeed in the course
- Tutor students in subjects like computer science and math

projects.title: QuickSale
projects.description:
- Designed and developed an iOS that allows users to sell any unused items around the house
- Integrated iOS Core ML to enhance a unique feature of the app, which detects the object in the picture and helps generate the posting information of the items 
- Implemented a map view using MapKit framework to display all the listed items
- Used Firebase to assure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application and users. Firebase was used to authenticate users, stored, and maintain application's data

projects.title: Alpha Fitness
projects.description:
- Developed an Android application to maintain workout information 
- Exploited built in sensor to gather information for every workout like: steps counter, and geographic location
- Optimized the app runtime and workload by using background thread and intent service to calculate and persist user's data
- Adopted Google Map to display the user's location and workout route
